source.licenseEvidenceStatus: The authoritative B2SHARE record exposes Rights > License, but no licence value is present.

requiredEvidence: An explicit dataset licence or written reuse permission from SKZ/B2SHARE is captured.
The captured terms permit automated ingestion and aggregate profiling.
The exact v1 file manifest and checksums are revalidated at retrieval time.

profilingPlanAfterRightsClearance: Retrieve one canonical representation of each logical table and verify its publisher checksum; use the paired CSV/Parquet forms for schema/equivalence validation, not as independent evidence.
Confirm all 68 cycle identifiers and the 17-setting by four-repeat grouping from delivered data rather than relying only on description text.
Profile time-resolved viscometer pressure separately from cycle-level machine settings, EUROMAP77 values and quality fields.
Establish the pressure-series time/index basis and delivered sample length per cycle before accepting any high-frequency measured-sample count.
Do not double-count identical measurements represented in both CSV and Parquet files.
Separate directly measured pressure/machine values from setpoints, identifiers, derived fields and quality labels.
Emit only aggregate schemas, counts and fingerprints; do not commit or artifact raw third-party rows or arrays.
evidenceBoundary: SKZ/B2SHARE provides a scientifically valuable waveform dataset with 68 injection-moulding cycles, 17 unique settings repeated four times, time-resolved nozzle-viscometer pressure, EUROMAP77 machine data and a quality table. The publisher record also exposes exact file names, sizes and MD5 checksums. However, the authoritative Rights > License field is blank. Therefore the source remains non-executable and contributes no accepted measured-sample count until explicit reuse terms are captured.
